Lineage of the reading transmission (lung) of the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772) as received by Bu ston (ID:5999): from rNgog lo tsA ba (ID:3786) to Khyung Rin chen grags (ID:3809), rGya dmar Byang chub grags (ID:3834), Phywa ba (ID:3831), gTsang nag pa (ID:3839), Dar ma bkra shis (ID:6217), gNyal pa (i.e., gNyal zhig ‘Jam pa’i rdo rje (ID:3887)), Bo dong pa (probably (ID:3904)), lDong pa Grags pa dpal (ID:7761), Lho pa Grub seng (ID:7651), Tshad ma'i skyes bu (ID:6925), Bu ston (ID:5999). 
See also [CTAI38G9]: 928.
[CTAI38G9]: 939.  Lineage of the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774) according to Bu ston (ID:5999)’s student sGra tshad pa (ID:7772) or one of his students. After several other Indian figures it begins with gZhan phan bzang po (Parahitabhadra (ID:3798)), followed by rNgog lo tsA ba (ID:3786), Khyung Rin chen grags (ID:3809), rGya dmar (ID:3834), Cha pa (ID:3831), gTsang nag pa (ID:3839), Dan 'bag pa (ID:3840), gNyal zhig (ID:3887), Bo dong Rin chen (ID:3904), lDong[s] Grags pa dpal (ID:7761), <Lho pa> Grub pa seng ge (ID:7651), Tshad ma'i skyes bu (ID:6925), Bu ston (ID:5999), Thugs sras lo tsA ba (ID:7772).
